rules.title: Rules & Reference
rules.subtitle: Official Backgammon Guidelines
rules.objectiveText: Move all 15 of your checkers into your home board and bear them off the board before your opponent. The first player to bear off all 15 checkers wins.
rules.movementWhite: White moves in reverse order from point 24 down to point 1 (into home board 1–6).
rules.movementBlack: Black moves from point 1 up to point 24 (into home board 19–24).
rules.movementDoubles: Rolling doubles (e.g. 5-5) grants four moves of that value instead of 2.
rules.movementMustPlay: You must play all possible dice. If only one of two different dice can be played, you must play the higher one.
rules.hittingBlot: A single checker on a point is a Blot. If an opponent lands on it, it is hit and placed on the Bar.
rules.hittingReenter: Checkers on the bar must re-enter into the opponent's home board before any other checkers can move.
rules.hittingBlocked: Points with 2 or more opponent checkers are blocked and cannot be landed on.
rules.cubeSingle: Single Win (1x): Opponent has borne off at least 1 checker.
rules.cubeGammon: Gammon (2x): Opponent has borne off 0 checkers.
rules.cubeBackgammon: Backgammon (3x): Opponent has borne off 0 checkers and has a checker on the bar or in the winner's home board.
rules.cubeRaise: The Doubling Cube allows players to raise the game value to 2x, 4x, 8x, up to 64x before rolling.
